title: cynanchum sublanceolatum var. dickinsii
intro: Cynanchum sublanceolatum var. dickinsii, commonly known as the Korean snake root or Dongbaekjeon, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum sublanceolatum var. dickinsii include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
